The constant drama and conflict on social media often leads to real-world fights. Shut it down for 7 hours a day.

Here's another example of overprotection in the real world: banning peanuts from schools caused kids antifragile immune systems to develop improperly, leading to peanut allergies, as @glukianoff and I wrote about. (Meanwhile no protections online)

Many teachers say class is better when they get rid of the Chromebooks too. 

Multifunction devices guarantee distraction.  We need distraction-free schools. No phones, no Chromebooks.

The avg young person today is on course to spend 25 years of their life on their phone. (Plus more on other screens). Most of them don't want to live this way, but feel trapped. 

How about we delay giving smartphones and tablets till at least 14?

https://t.co/aJMaAxcMrD https://t.co/dEg3SIMIxG

Sweden will makes its schools phone free!
They are also pulling back on edtech.
They recognize that multifunction devices make it harder for students to learn. 

https://t.co/hHnfROyGy6

Thank you @VivekGRamaswamy. Yes!

This is one of the few major issues that is completely bipartisan. Red states and blue states are getting phones out of schools. 
Let's do this, together.

Denmark will ban phones in schools. “And if we find out in five years that it was better with the phones, we can reintroduce them. But I don’t think that will be the case.”

https://t.co/5o0by7ot5e

Gov. @SarahHuckabee of Arkansas launched a program last summer to support schools that chose to go phone free. 

The early results are so spectacular that she's now introducing a bill to make all schools phone free, from bell to bell. Go Sarah!

https://t.co/3txQoi4Qot

Arkansas shows how easy it is to improve schools by going phone free. Gov. @SarahHuckabee put up money that schools could choose to use. Huge response from schools. I spoke with a few classes; the kids love it too, when nobody is on a phone. So much more fun!

It is amazing how quickly schools improve when a governor makes a clear statement about phone-free schools and puts up some money that schools can choose to use to go phone-free. 

Arkansas is indeed leading the way; thank you Gov. @SarahHuckabee

When schools go phone free, the results are great -- once you get past the first few weeks and withdrawal symptoms. It's working in NY state schools, and Gov. Hochul will call for it statewide:

https://t.co/a4biSkY9Va

South Carolina schools will go phone free, throughout the day! 

Red states, blue states.... everyone wants kids to pay attention to their teachers and to other students. Most people see that phones interfere with education and social connection.

https://t.co/gwlDV8Avey
More fantastic news: Virginia schools will go phone free. Well done Gov. Youngkin. Red, blue, and purple states are doing it. Politicians in both parties are parents, they see what is happening.
